spans.s: 1. yāmá, a. (ī́) derived from, relating 🞄to, or meant for Yama.
2. yā́m-a, m. [√ yam] cessation, conclusion 🞄(V.).

yám-ana, a. (ī) restraining, guiding 🞄(V.);
 n. act of restraining or curbing.
yamā-ya, den. Ā. represent the god 🞄of death.

yama‿ari, m. Yamaʼs foe, ep. of 🞄Viṣṇu;
 -ālaya, m. Yamaʼs abode.
yam-in, a. self-controlled.

yam-ī́, f. twin-sister of Yama;
 in C. 🞄= yamunā.
yāmi, incorr. for जामि jāmi.

yāmuná, a. belonging to, coming 🞄from, or growing in the Yamunā;
 n. kind of 🞄collyrium.
yamuṣa-deva, kind of fabric.

yāma-ka-kareṇukā, f. female 🞄elephant standing ready at appointed hours;
 🞄-kuñjara, m. elephant —.
yāma-kareṇukā, f., -kuñjara, 🞄m. id..
yāmak-in-ī, f. female servant on 🞄guard or watch.

yām-in-ī, f. (having watches), 🞄night;
 N.: -dayita, m. lover —, -nātha or 🞄-pati, m. lord —, -priya-tama, -ramana, m. 🞄lover of night, moon.
